purpose: Continue the active three-session historical research goal after Campaign126 by reviewing a finite point-in-time source catalog against all 149 complete definitions before any Campaign127 provider row, factor value, comparator value, price or return is opened.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: convertible_issue_online_demand_180d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The documented issuance-result announcement date supplies a conservative information clock, online excess subscription is a primary-market demand measure rather than a stock-price transform, and cb_basic supplies a bond-to-underlying-stock relation without requiring a 5000-point source.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: convertible_issue_dilution_or_absolute_financing_size
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Issue amount, plan amount and completion ratio mix financing scale, firm size and dilution. Selecting among those fields after seeing coverage would be a same-source field sweep; only online demand may proceed.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: convertible_bond_rating_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Rating changes are sparse credit-review events with a separate ordinal text mapping and are adjacent to the terminal audit/reliability event family. They are not admitted as a fallback if issuance demand fails.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: index_membership_or_weight_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Effective constituent dates and weights do not by themselves establish when a historical rebalance announcement became public. No stable 2019-2025 publication clock is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: public_fund_disclosed_ownership_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The official fund portfolio source requires 5000 points and the user explicitly authorized continuing without such premium data. It is not a dependency or fallback.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: company_announcement_or_investor_interaction_text_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A text-model search would introduce an unbounded label, prompt and fitting space after extensive event-source exposure. No finite ex-ante vocabulary, historical transport contract or leakage-safe publication archive is frozen.

selected_candidate.name: convertible_issue_online_demand_180d
selected_candidate.candidate_measure: log1p of online excess subscription multiple
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Strong online demand for a completed convertible-bond issue reveals broad primary-market attention to the issuer; among issuers with a result announced in the preceding 180 calendar days, stronger demand may persist into near-term stock price discovery.
